name: task-manager
description: MERN Task Manager - Express + MongoDB API with a React + TypeScript client

scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c yellow,blue,green "npm run dev -w shared" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test
